why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Mickey Moniak is slot #4 (4.292 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #3, #7, #5, #6, #2, #8, #1, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.30 expected PA/game vs 4.52 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
